conditions.title: Package 1 lineage, V10-B, and V10-B-1 are inherited
Package 1 remains frozen and unchanged
Club affiliation remains the first implementation vertical
The full affiliation lifecycle has delivery destinations
House and Button responsibilities remain distinct
External providers retain no institutional decision authority
Every material inherited requirement maps to a work package or governed disposition
Work packages define scope, exclusions, dependencies, deliverables, readiness, completion, and evidence
House domain, application, persistence, and infrastructure slices are represented
Button experience and staff-workbench slices are represented
Actor, organization, jurisdiction, authority, delegation, assignment, and service-identity boundaries are represented
Requirement, evidence, completeness, submission, review, return, resubmission, decision, reconciliation, activation, standing, and expiry are represented
Database-integrity and PostgreSQL-behaviour evidence destinations are defined
Exactly-once activation remains a business invariant rather than a transport claim
API, query, event, outbox, webhook, provider, file, batch, and exchange implementation destinations are defined
Provider requirements remain distinct from provider selection or engagement
Migration planning preserves provenance, uncertainty, quarantine, coexistence, reconciliation, rollback, and acceptance distinctions
Identity resolution remains distinct from migration mapping
Security, privacy, records, accessibility, bilingual, data, financial, and audit obligations are embedded
Environment and test-enablement requirements trace to Volume 9
Environment planning remains distinct from provisioning and qualification
Test-enablement planning remains distinct from executable tests and execution
Estimates identify basis, range, confidence, assumptions, dependencies, and approval status
Estimates remain distinct from budgets, quotes, procurements, and contracts
Capability requirements remain distinct from staffing assignments or engagements
Release units identify required evidence, rollback dependencies, acceptance authority, and future gates
Release units remain distinct from accepted releases and deployments
House P0 findings have implementation, test-enablement, operational-proof, and release-evidence destinations
Every unresolved item has an owner, required evidence, and valid future gate
Deterministic Package 2 analysis completes without blocking defects
No runtime code, executable tests, environment, dataset, identity, credential, secret, provider integration, migration, or infrastructure is created
No procurement, expenditure, staff assignment, provider engagement, provisioning, test execution, pilot, rollout, deployment, release, or launch is authorized
No estimate, target date, resource model, implementation-readiness state, or release-candidate state is represented as approved without evidence
No record authorizes implementation
Genuine authoring, closure/freeze, and pre-merge provenance-binding separation is preserved
